title: Longest Subarray with Sum At Most K
statement:
Given an array of positive integers and a value K, find the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose sum is less than or equal to K.

Use the two-pointer (sliding window) technique.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated positive integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest subarray with sum <= K.

examples.explanation: Any 3 consecutive 1s sum to 3, giving length 3.

starterCode.python:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here
# Hint: expand right, shrink left when sum > k
